# React (JavaScript)

A JavaScript web app using React and Robo.js.

<Cards>
  <Card href="/docs/web-apps" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template web-apps/react-js
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## App Development

Build your web app in the `/src/app` folder using React.

## Backend Development

Your server-side code is in the `/src/api` folder:
